newsitem.title: USA: Muni bond sales at $4.8 bln for week of June 9.
newsitem.headline: Muni bond sales at $4.8 bln for week of June 9.

text.p: Municipal bond sales for the week of June 9 are expected to total nearly $4.8 billion in 152 deals, the largest weekly total so far in 1997, according to Reuters Municipal Bond Information Group.
Negotiated offerings total $2.7 billion in 63 sales, with a $540 million Puerto Rico Public Building Authority deal through Smith Barney Inc. topping the list.
On the competitive side, 89 sales totaling $2 billion are scheduled. A $225 million Virginia Housing Development Authority issue on Tuesday is the largest.
An additional 13 sales totaling $488 million are on the possible calender, meaning underwriters have said they may price the issues this week depending on market conditions.
